questions._flag: CBSE ACCEPTS TWO DIFFERENT ANSWERS ON PART (b). The marking scheme (ms idx 3) prints the expected answer 'X, because reaction is SN1 / due to formation of planar carbocation as intermediate' and then, in bold immediately under it, 'Award full marks if the students write Y which is optically active.' Per the addendum's rule table that is the 'EITHER OF TWO answers accepted' shape (any format), so it is recorded in _cbseVoided rather than as plain marking latitude. NOTE A DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE FROM THE OPENER: 2026-56-1-1 carries this identical printed question as its Q28 and recorded the same note as a _flag only, arguing it is 'an acknowledged second acceptable answer, not a void'. The substance behind it: 'X' (2-bromo-2-methylpropane) is achiral, so racemisation is strictly meaningless for it, while 'Y' (2-bromobutane) is the optically active substrate a student may reasonably read part (b) as being about.
